theme: mesh route weights LOOKUP OR default + KVDEL drain

tests.name: seed_get
tests.cmd: seed peer_a:10 peer_b:5 peer_c:1; get peer_a → 10 OR=0

tests.name: get_or_require
tests.cmd: REQUIRE get missing → exit 2 default only

tests.name: pin_set_seed
tests.cmd: pin peer_b; set peer_d; seed skip peer_a

weaknesses.title: LOOKUP OR sets OK=1 on miss — silent default
weaknesses.detail: Agents that only check OK treat missing peer as success. Must inspect LOOKUP_OR or LOOKUP_I==-1. Asymmetric with bare LOOKUP miss OK=0.
weaknesses.repro: LOOKUP bag ghost OR 1 → OK=1 LOOKUP_OR=1

weaknesses.title: KVDEL miss keeps OK=1 with HIT=0
weaknesses.detail: Unlike LOOKUP miss, KVDEL never soft-fails OK. REQUIRE paths must gate on KVDEL_HIT not OK. Easy to think del always succeeded.

weaknesses.title: KVDEL first-only leaves duplicate residual keys
weaknesses.detail: peer_a:1\npeer_a:9 after del peer_a keeps peer_a:9. No DELALL / multi-key policy. Drain incomplete without loop.

weaknesses.title: Zero default weight makes hit=0 look like miss
weaknesses.detail: Program maps hit=val_n; DEF=0 → hit=0 while get succeeded with default. Agents conflate success with non-zero weight.

weaknesses.title: LOOKUP sep+OR argument order is fragile
weaknesses.detail: Correct: LOOKUP bag key \"=\" OR \"x\". Wrong: LOOKUP bag key OR \"x\" \"=\" → unknown form '='. Same sep-literal class as prior KV ops.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses bag newlines
weaknesses.detail: Stable issue; route plate looks like single field in JSON dump.

weaknesses.title: No KVDEL ALL / WHILE-HIT loop primitive
weaknesses.detail: Draining all duplicate keys needs agent WHILE LOOKUP loop. MEANINGFUL_ITER candidate.

workarounds: Always check LOOKUP_OR after LOOKUP … OR; REQUIRE on used_or if real peer required
Gate del on KVDEL_HIT not OK
Loop KVDEL while LOOKUP hits for full drain of dups
Report used_or and val separately; never use hit==0 alone as miss when DEF can be 0
sep before OR: bag key \":\" OR DEF with string literals only
language_gaps: LOOKUP OR option to keep OK=0 on default (STRICT_OR)
KVDEL hard-miss mode OK=0 when HIT=0
